controls.subject:
The editor's own 3D detection, promoting textures to VRAM Compressed

Godot saw these used on 3D materials and promoted them, which is what
detect_3d/compress_to=1 asks for and the end state the policy wants:
vram_texture true, imported_formats s3tc_bptc, and the .s3tc path beside the
plain one. Committed from the consuming project, where the editor did the
detecting.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>
